Keep something under wraps.english_meaning: To keep something secret or hidden.

Break a leg.english_meaning: An expression used to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance.

Look before you leap.english_meaning: Consider the consequences carefully before acting.

Better late than never.english_meaning: It's better for something to happen or be done late than not at all.

In the nick of time.english_meaning: Just in time; at the last possible moment.

Beat the clock.english_meaning: To finish something before a deadline or time runs out.

Call it a day.english_meaning: To decide to stop working on something for the day.

Penny-wise and pound-foolish.english_meaning: Careful with small amounts of money but wasteful with large amounts.

On cloud nine.meaning: En el séptimo cielo / Muy feliz

Step up to the plate.meaning: Dar un paso al frente / Asumir la responsabilidad

Think outside the box.meaning: Pensar de manera creativa / Romper esquemas
Think outside the box.english_meaning: To think creatively, beyond conventional ideas.

Climb the ladder.english_meaning: To advance in one's career or social status.

Call the shots.meaning: Tomar las decisiones / Llevar la batuta

Hit the ground running.meaning: Empezar con fuerza / Ponerse manos a la obra

Back on your feet.meaning: Recuperarse / Volver a estar en pie

Out of sorts.english_meaning: Feeling slightly unwell or in a bad mood.

Let sleeping dogs lie.meaning: No despertar al perro que duerme / No remover problemas antiguos

Hold your horses.english_meaning: Wait, be patient, or slow down.

Bring home the bacon.meaning: Ganar el sustento / Mantener a la familia
Bring home the bacon.english_meaning: To earn money to support one's family.

Apple of one’s eye.english_meaning: Someone who is cherished above all others.

Every cloud has a silver lining.meaning: No hay mal que por bien no venga

Rain on someone’s parade.meaning: Arruinarle la fiesta a alguien / Echar a perder algo

Chase rainbows.english_meaning: To pursue an unrealistic or unattainable goal.

Come rain or shine.meaning: Pase lo que pase / Con lluvia o sol
Come rain or shine.english_meaning: Regardless of circumstances or difficulties; no matter what happens.

Go the extra mile.meaning: Hacer un esfuerzo adicional / Ir más allá
Go the extra mile.english_meaning: To make an extra effort beyond what is expected.

Off the beaten track.meaning: Fuera de lo común / En un lugar remoto
Off the beaten track.english_meaning: In a remote or unusual place, away from popular routes.

Take the plunge.english_meaning: To decide to do something risky or important after hesitating.

Make a long story short.meaning: Para no hacer larga la historia / En resumen
Make a long story short.english_meaning: To summarize; to give the essential facts without unnecessary detail.

Take with a grain of salt.english_meaning: To view something with skepticism; not to take it entirely at face value.

Throw caution to the wind.meaning: Echar la cautela al viento / Arriesgarse

Cross that bridge when you come to it.english_meaning: To deal with a problem only when it actually happens, not before.

In hot water.english_meaning: In trouble or a difficult situation.

Playing with fire.meaning: Jugar con fuego / Tomar riesgos innecesarios

Keep your eyes peeled.meaning: Mantener los ojos bien abiertos / Estar atento
Keep your eyes peeled.english_meaning: To watch carefully or stay alert for something.

Jump on the bandwagon.meaning: Subirse al carro / Seguir la tendencia
Jump on the bandwagon.english_meaning: To join others in doing something popular or fashionable.

Let bygones be bygones.meaning: Lo pasado, pasado / Dejar atrás rencores
Let bygones be bygones.english_meaning: To forget past conflicts or offenses and move forward.

Walk on very thin ice.meaning: En terreno peligroso / Al borde del problema

Pull someone’s leg.english_meaning: To tease or joke with someone, often by telling them something untrue.

Wash your hands of something.english_meaning: To refuse to take further responsibility for something.

The ship has sailed.meaning: se te pasó el tren / ya es demasiado tarde

Walking on eggshells.meaning: andar con pies de plomo / actuar con mucho cuidado
Walking on eggshells.english_meaning: Being very careful not to upset or offend someone.

Working your fingers to the bone.english_meaning: Working extremely hard, often to the point of exhaustion.

Speak of the Devil.english_meaning: Said when a person being discussed suddenly appears or is mentioned.

Green thumb.meaning: tener buena mano para las plantas
Green thumb.english_meaning: A natural talent for gardening and growing plants.

On the fence.meaning: estar entre dos aguas / estar indeciso

Ring a bell.english_meaning: To sound familiar; to remind someone of something.

Black eye.english_meaning: A bruise around the eye, typically caused by a blow.

Turning the tables.meaning: darle la vuelta a la tortilla / dar la vuelta a la situación

Wearing many hats.meaning: desempeñar muchos papeles / hacer de todo
Wearing many hats.english_meaning: Performing several different roles or jobs at once.

Old school.english_meaning: Traditional or conventional in style or values.

Hot potato.english_meaning: A controversial or sensitive issue that is difficult to deal with.

Showing one's true colors.english_meaning: Revealing one's real character or intentions, often after pretending otherwise.

Turn a blind eye.english_meaning: To deliberately ignore something wrong or improper.

Knock someone's socks off.meaning: dejar a alguien con la boca abierta / impresionar muchísimo a alguien

A stone's throw away.meaning: a tiro de piedra / muy cerca

Sit tight.english_meaning: To wait patiently and not take action.

Drive someone nuts.meaning: volver loco a alguien / sacar de quicio

Back to square one.meaning: volver a la casilla de salida / volver al punto de partida
Back to square one.english_meaning: Back to the starting point, as if no progress had been made.

Cut the mustard.meaning: estar a la altura / cumplir las expectativas
Cut the mustard.english_meaning: To meet expectations or perform to the required standard.

Cold turkey.meaning: dejar algo de golpe y sin ayuda

Be a night owl.english_meaning: To be someone who is naturally more active or alert late at night.

Be over the moon.meaning: estar en las nubes de felicidad / estar muy feliz / encantado
Be over the moon.english_meaning: To be extremely happy or delighted.

Beat around the bush.meaning: andar por las ramas / no ir al grano
Beat around the bush.english_meaning: To avoid talking about something directly; to speak evasively.
